While the island once was entirely a part of West Metropolis Archipelago, following subsequent changes of the border between Downtown and West Metropolis Archipelago, the eastern part of the island is now a part of Downtown.

title: Old Brightland
safeHtml:
'''Old Brightland''' is a development area in TriPaw. Old Brightland in the boarder sense includes the Nawis Railway route section between Chimes Canyon Station and Island Gales Station.

History

Old Brightland

In the narrower sense, Old Brightland only includes the area to the east of Koishi Road and the south of Gangut Road. Folklores have suggested the existence of a duke in the Old Brightland Area who built his Cottage in where Ayanami Street is today. As that duke had given financial help to many villagers in times of natural disasters, the villagers nearby had revered him and named him "The Bright Duke". Tragically, the cottage remained empty after his death as he did not have any offsprings, and the Cottage was hence named "Old Brightland" in order to commeorate him.

As time goes by, the cottage fell in disrepair, and after Nawis Railway begun construction begun in Old Brightland, a concensus was made with the residents of that area to demolish the cottage under the conditions that residents can move into the new Private Housing in Old Brihgtland for free. Most residents involved currently live in Wing Lok Building, and the building is one of the main private housing developments in Old Brightland. Currently, these buildings are home to a population of 5'000.

Myosotis Valley

Myosotis Valley refers to the area to the west of Koishi Road, the south of Old Brightland Avenue and the east of Echo Road South. Myosotis Valley used to be a low valley that is home to a small settlement. While the settlement was originally named "Tsurume", the name changed to Myosotis Valley for a mysterious reason. However, legends have it that a traveller who was chased down by a Mafia Gang Member went in hiding in this settlement and fell in love with one of the female villagers. While the both of them fell in love and could have lived happily ever after, the Mafia Gang member managed to find this settlemenet, and in order to not harm the innocents, the traveller left a farewell letter to the girl at dawn. In turn, the girl told him that she will hold a "forget-me-not" flower to wait for him, but he never returned. To commemorate this tragic love story, Tsurume was renamed Myosotis Valley.

When development in Myosotis Valley began, the developer promised that the villagers could live in Tin Lok Gardens for free in order to gain support from villagers. Currently, Myosotis Valley has a series of private housing, as well as two public housing estates, and is home to 6'000 people.

Island Gales

Island Gales refer to the area near Island Gales Station of Nawis Railway. While there are no residents in that area before development, legends have it there used to be an island which lays in the middle of a river mouth, and people who stand on that island could feel large gales blowing towards him, hence the name Island Gales. However, the River Mouth has since been reclaimed due to development. Currently, Island Gales has a few separate private housing buildings and is home to the only Secondary School in this area.

Future Development

Currently, development in Myosotis Valley and Old Brightland South is complete, but the Old Brightland University to the northeast is still under construction. It is seen that once this university complete constructions, 40'000 quotas can be given for university students.
